## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_正财 (Water carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Earth. structural_interaction seed: "Earth directing Water cross-polarity — stability containing depth into productive form".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Steward: current disciplined into irrigation. You manage flows, income streams, schedules, family logistics, with the calm of a well-run canal. Nothing floods, nothing dries. It is unglamorous mastery, and every life around you runs smoother because your channels hold."
- k2_functional: "You administer gracefully: systems, budgets, routines that run without drought."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Dammed-up","Wary","Can’t let go"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is flow-managed: salaries channeled, streams diversified, leaks found early. You prosper by routing, not risking. Map the canals once a year and fortune stays irrigated.","Savings":"You save in reservoirs: automatic diversions filling quiet pools. Name each pool’s purpose, storm, harvest, joy, and the discipline becomes drinkable.","Steady love":"You love in reliable supply: presence delivered daily, needs anticipated, storms weathered by good infrastructure. Choose someone who notices plumbing. Then surprise the schedule occasionally. Even canals enjoy weather."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]

- Sibling cell 水_偏财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Far-flowing","Adaptive","Magnetic"],"friction":["Up and down","Ungrounded","Everywhere at once"]}
- Sibling cell 水_偏财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your reach extends the way rivers extend, finding distant ground that stay-at-home currents never touch. The overseas client, the cousin of a stranger, the market two time zones away: your opportunities live at range, and distance has never once read as an obstacle to you."

Core element Earth, energy element Water. Law: Earth tames Water (土克水: banks give the river its path). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Water is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Earth core that shows Water on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Water as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 土_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You save before you spend, every time. Something put away lets you relax, so you save a little from every month rather than enjoy all of one. Spend one saved month on something you want, and you learn what the saving was for.

value_b.text: Saving comes before wanting in you. A full account feels more like safety than a full life does, and you put the account first. Let one want through each season, since saving is only worth it when some of it gets spent.

value.text: Saving first is how you stay calm. You put money away ahead of anything you would enjoy, because the account quiets your worry. Spend some on yourself every so often, and you stop paying for safety with the years you save for.

value.text: Saving first hands your people the careful version of you. You put the savings ahead of the trip together, and give them caution instead of company. Spend one saved thing on them a year, and you hand them the part of you the saving protects.

value.text: You sleep on a decision before you make it, even a small one. Waiting a night costs nothing and hurrying costs plenty, so you would rather lose a day than a deal. Sleep on the big ones, and decide the small ones before bed.

value_b.text: A night's sleep goes into every decision you make. Being sure matters more than being quick to you, and waiting is how you came by most of what is yours. Sleep on the big choices, and let one small yes out the same day.

value.text: Sleeping on a choice keeps your money safe, and it keeps you late. You wait a night ahead of saying yes, since being wrong costs more. Say yes the same day once a season, and you stop losing chances to whoever answered first.

value.text: Whenever you sleep on an answer, you leave someone waiting overnight. You would rather be sure tomorrow than quick today, and you hand the wait to whoever asked. Give the small answers before bed, and you keep the patience of the people around you.

value.text: You show up every day the same way, noticed or not. Being counted on matters more to you than being exciting, so you show up on dull days too. Show up for yourself once a week as well, since steady love needs a steady supply.

value_b.text: Showing up is the whole of how you love. You count an ordinary evening for more than flowers once a year. Bring flowers on an ordinary evening now and then, and you show up in a way that gets seen.

value.text: Showing up daily is your way of staying sure of someone. You keep the routine ahead of your rest, since a missed day feels like a crack. Miss one on purpose now and again, and you get the rest showing up runs on.

value.text: What you give the ones you love is that you keep showing up. You hand them presence rather than surprise, and you let them know each day's shape in advance. Change the shape once a month, and you add something to look forward to.
